1018-5232-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
1018-5232-8043.description:
Cast Clone Legion for free due to Vision, creating a token copy of each creature you control.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Skullwinder token enters, it triggers, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1659-7084-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
1659-7084-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Seed the Land triggers, creating a 1/1 green Snake creature token
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2023-3755-4518-4885.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2353-4691-7841.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2353-4691-7841.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2 until your library is empty, preventing a game loss with Darksteel Angel.

1495-2060-3899-5544-6431.manaNeeded: {B} if Crystalline Crawler does not have a +1/+1 counter on it
1495-2060-3899-5544-6431.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
If able, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Triskelion ability from step 3.
Repeat.

789-2738-3967-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Gutter Grime, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

654-1308-6441-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3946-4572-7705.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

2034-7430--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Gorma trigger.
Resolve the Gorma trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gorma.
Remove a +1/+1 and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Repeat.
2034-7430--5.notes: Each loop, Gorma will place an additional +1/+1 counter on the persist creature compared to the previous loop. This'll eventually result in both the persist creature and Gorma having infinite +1/+1 counters on them.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4762-4772-6260.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Doubling Season and Caradora.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

3490-4659-5070-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4659-5070-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

628-5007-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.
628-5007-5686.notes: The remaining -1/-1 counter can be removed each loop to gain infinite colored mana.

129-4222-5814.description:
Activated Delighted Halfling by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast legendary spells.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Delighted Halfling.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1115-3259-7279.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-3259-7279.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker.
Razorkin Hordecaller triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5226-6972-7160.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Arcbound Whelp.
When Arcbound Whelp dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Whelp's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Whelp from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

1939-3490-4659-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1939-3490-4659-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Lunarch Veteran or Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain life
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3490-4017-4050-4506.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4017-4050-4506.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1329-1482-4404.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Jeweled Lotus.
Cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Corridor Monitor.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

969-1170-1329-1482.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard.
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

277-3293-5412-5721.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
277-3293-5412-5721.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd and Tiller Engine trigger that many times.
Resolve all Tiller Engine triggers, untapping each land that entered.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
277-3293-5412-5721.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1681-4140-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Twilight Shepherd.
When Twilight Shepherd dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Giada.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

3492-3609-4112-5900.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Sharuum.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

1115-1563-2351-6460.easyPrerequisites:
You control a token.
It is an opponent's turn.
1115-1563-2351-6460.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token.
If you sacrificed a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature token was a Tentacle, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate the Tentacle by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

2034-3490-6097-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
2034-3490-6097-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Hinterland Sanctifier indestructible.
2034-3490-6097-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

1287-1887-4918-6320.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Lightning Runner.
1287-1887-4918-6320.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Aethertide Whale with haste.
When the Aethertide Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get twelve {E}.
Declare Lightning Runner as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E} and then pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

224-803-2366-3346-5220.notablePrerequisites:
Bog Glider does not have summoning sickness.
"Mercenary" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
224-803-2366-3346-5220.description:
Activate Bog Glider by tapping it and sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Dryad Arbor on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bog Glider ability from step 1, searching your library for Dryad Arbor and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Bog Glider.
Repeat.

2564-3603-4125-4231.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, blinking Shipwreck Dowser.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it and Lonis trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

81-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Kami of Whispered Hopes does not have summoning sickness and has a power of at least two.
81-4222.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Repeat.

1978-3151-5056.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Elves.
1978-3151-5056.description:
Cause Elvish Archdruid to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Elvish Archdruid.
Repeat from step 2.
